messages:
nina: kicking off staged rollout v1.13.1 -> canary 8% (eu-central). change window 09:00-11:00 CET. release notes: https://redwood/release/v1.13.1 :sparkles:

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT r-3533 started. target=canary:8% eu-central. monitors: p95_latency, 5xx_rate, semantic-sim.

drew: quick sanity: smoke checks OK. starting lightweight A/B on 2 nodes to sanity-check embeddings and reranker.

prod-monitor: alert: p95_latency increased from 110ms -> 200ms on canary subset (eu-central) over 4m.

nina: seeing p95 spike correlated with a subset of long-context requests (>2048 tokens). any logs?

ops_lead: recommend pausing ramp and pin rollout while we triage. pin if necessary.

deploy-bot: pin command queued: `deploy-bot pin r-3533 --reason "p95 spike long-context"`. pinned. state=paused_at_8pct. audit: ops_lead at 3533334399.

drew: logs snippet:
```
[09:20:11] infer-node-5: req=qq1 seq_len=4096 latency=312ms mem=86%
[09:20:12] kv-cache: miss for prefix=large_prompt
[09:20:13] reranker: score drop noticed for req=qq1
```

eval-bot: running ev-920: long-context prompt set (N=200). ETA ~10m.

nina: we should also consider temporarily routing long-context traffic to a fallback smaller model until we validate. thoughts?

ops_lead: prefer evaluation first. fallback is plan B if regression confirmed. rollback plan ready: `deploy-bot rollback r-3533 --to v1.13.0 --notify cs-team`

eval-bot: ev-920 complete. result: long-context pass_rate=87% baseline=94% delta=-7pp. flagged. full report: https://redwood/evals/ev-920

drew: that's a clear regression on long-context. recommend rollback.

nina: agree. deploying rollback to v1.13.0 and notifying CS.

deploy-bot: executing: `deploy-bot rollback r-3533 --to v1.13.0 --notify "cs-team@redwood" --reason "long-context latency & quality regression"`

deploy-bot: rollback finished. traffic reverted to v1.13.0. state=rolled_back. audit: nina at 3533334538.

ops_lead: post-rollback checklist: collect failing long-context prompts, reproduce in staging with larger KV cache, run targeted perf tests, consider kernel memory settings. schedule follow-up triage at 12:00 CET.

nina: CS notified. closing thread until patch validated. :white_check_mark:
